comments.body:
Root cause (session a85e3cd3, 2026-11-03). Confirmed from primary sources; the fix is paused on a design decision.

Finding 1: dockerd parses builder.gc, so the Engine version decides which key works, not the BuildKit version. builder.gc.maxUsedSpace (the key directly under gc) is ignored on every Engine version.
- moby daemon/config/builder.go, BuilderGCConfig. v25.0.0 through v27.5.1 (the last 27.x tag) have only Enabled, Policy and DefaultKeepStorage. v28.0.0 adds DefaultReservedSpace, DefaultMaxUsedSpace and DefaultMinFreeSpace, and remaps the deprecated DefaultKeepStorage to DefaultReservedSpace. MaxUsedSpace exists only on BuilderGCRule, which is a policy[] entry. Go's encoding/json matches field names case-insensitively, but maxUsedSpace never matches DefaultMaxUsedSpace, so the key is dropped without an error. https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/v28.0.0/daemon/config/builder.go and https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/v27.5.1/daemon/config/builder.go
- moby daemon/config/config.go v28.0.0 lists "builder" in skipValidateOptions. That means `dockerd --validate` never flags unknown keys under builder.gc, so the script's validate step cannot catch this.
- The BuildKit version does not stand in for the Engine version. From moby vendor.mod: Engine 25.0.x ships BuildKit 0.12.5, 26.0/26.1 ship 0.13.1, 27.0.1 ships 0.14.1, 27.3.0 ships 0.16.0, 27.4.0 ships 0.17.3, 27.5.1 ships 0.18.2, 28.0.0 ships 0.20.0 and 28.5.0 ships 0.25.0. A BuildKit >= 0.17 boundary would still write the new key on Engine 27.4 and 27.5, whose struct cannot read it. moby builder/builder-next/controller.go at v27.5.1 leaves the new options unwired ("FIXME ... wire up new options", moby/moby#48639). v28.0.0 getGCPolicy passes DefaultReservedSpace, DefaultMaxUsedSpace and DefaultMinFreeSpace to DefaultGCPolicy.
- BuildKit v0.17.0 release notes are the first to mention the limits: "define reserved and maximum storage limits separately #5359 #5079". The v0.13.0 through v0.16.0 notes have no GC-space entries. https://github.com/moby/buildkit/releases/tag/v0.17.0
- Bug 3057 credited the ignored key to BuildKit 0.12.6. Engine 25.0.16's own struct has no maxUsedSpace field, so dockerd dropped the key before BuildKit ever saw it.

Finding 2: defaultKeepStorage alone still caps the cache on Engine 28 and later.
- On Engine 28, defaultKeepStorage becomes DefaultReservedSpace. moby builder/builder-next/worker/gc.go v28.0.0 DefaultGCPolicy infers percentage defaults only when reserved, max and min-free are all zero. BuildKit v0.20.0 cache/manager.go calculateKeepBytes then works out to max(0, reserved) = reserved, so it prunes down to 5 GiB just as the old keepBytes did. moby master still accepts DefaultKeepStorage as a deprecated alias.

Finding 3 (filed separately): the readback parses only "Keep Bytes:". docker/buildx commands/inspect.go prints "Keep Bytes:" through v0.17.0. From v0.18.0 on it prints "Reserved Space:", "Max Used Space:" and "Min Free Space:" instead. After a buildx CLI upgrade, --check-gc-enforced and the --install readback would report "unreadable" permanently.

Production impact: none today. The host runs Engine 25.0.16 with BuildKit 0.12.6, the script takes the defaultKeepStorage branch, and Engine 25 parses that key.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

`infra/scripts/docker-storage-cap.sh` writes the BuildKit cache cap into `/etc/docker/daemon.json` under `builder.gc`. It picks the key from the BuildKit version: `maxUsedSpace` directly under `gc` at BuildKit >= 0.13 (`gc_schema_for`, `DOCKER_MODERN_GC_BUILDKIT_MAJOR/MINOR` at lines 89-90), otherwise `defaultKeepStorage`. The daemon ignores the modern key on every Engine version, so any host that crossed the boundary would carry a cap that reads as installed but does not exist. Production (rebar-gerrit: Engine 25.0.16, BuildKit 0.12.6) takes the `defaultKeepStorage` branch and is unaffected today.

Evidence (primary sources; full citations in this ticket's root-cause comment):
- dockerd, not BuildKit, parses `builder.gc`. moby `daemon/config/builder.go` `BuilderGCConfig` at v25.0.0 through v27.5.1 has only `Enabled`, `Policy` and `DefaultKeepStorage`. v28.0.0 adds `DefaultReservedSpace`/`DefaultMaxUsedSpace`/`DefaultMinFreeSpace`. `MaxUsedSpace` exists only on `BuilderGCRule` (a `policy[]` entry), so a gc-level `maxUsedSpace` is dropped on every Engine.
- moby `daemon/config/config.go` v28.0.0 lists `builder` in `skipValidateOptions`, so `dockerd --validate` (script line 457) cannot flag the ignored key.
- BuildKit v0.17.0 release notes are the first to add reserved/max storage limits (#5359, #5079). v0.13.0-v0.16.0 notes have none. The Engine/BuildKit pairing (moby vendor.mod: 27.4.0 ships 0.17.3, 27.5.1 ships 0.18.2) means no BuildKit cutoff matches what the daemon parses.
- `defaultKeepStorage` is read by every Engine from 25.0 through moby master. On Engine 28 it maps to `DefaultReservedSpace` (builder.go v28.0.0 UnmarshalJSON). With max-used and min-free unset, BuildKit v0.20.0 `cache/manager.go` `calculateKeepBytes` returns `max(0, reserved)`, so it is still enforced as the ceiling.

## Approach

Write one key on every host: `builder.gc.defaultKeepStorage`. The version cutoff has been wrong twice (Engine >= 25.0 in bug 3057, now BuildKit >= 0.13). The one key that every supported Engine reads removes the guess altogether. A future removal of the deprecated alias is caught by the existing read-back (`effective_gc_verdict`) and the `docker_buildkit_gc_enforced` alarm.

In `infra/scripts/docker-storage-cap.sh`:
- Delete `DOCKER_MODERN_GC_BUILDKIT_MAJOR/MINOR`, `probe_buildkit_version`, `gc_schema_for`, the `--buildkit-version` flag (an unknown argument then dies through the existing `*) die` arm), and the probe/warn block at lines 412-418.
- `render_daemon_json` always sets `gc["defaultKeepStorage"]` and pops `maxUsedSpace` plus the Engine 28 gc-level `defaultReservedSpace`, `defaultMaxUsedSpace` and `defaultMinFreeSpace`. A leftover `defaultReservedSpace` would override `defaultKeepStorage` on Engine 28 (builder.go v28.0.0 UnmarshalJSON only falls back when it is empty), and a leftover `defaultMaxUsedSpace` would raise the ceiling. Popping them keeps the share the only ceiling and removes a stale `maxUsedSpace` written by the old modern branch.
- Replace the `${schema}` wording in the warn messages with fixed text, and rewrite the header section "The rendered key depends on BuildKit version" and the mismatch warning (line 259) to state the dockerd-parses-it finding.

In `infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md` §"The BuildKit cap is not taking effect": replace the BuildKit-version paragraph with the single-key behaviour.

Out of scope: `infra/terraform/monitoring_autodeploy.tf`'s alarm description. Editing it creates a Terraform diff that only an apply clears, and production is read-only in this work. The buildx >= 0.18 read-back labels are bug flavoured-peridot-ankole, which follows this change.

## Scope

- `infra/scripts/docker-storage-cap.sh` — drop the version branch, single key, stale-key cleanup, comments/messages.
- `tests/scripts/test_docker_storage_cap.py` — replace the version-boundary tests.
- `infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md` — runbook paragraph.

## Testing

Written first, failing on the current tree, in `tests/scripts/test_docker_storage_cap.py` (stubs on PATH, no autouse fixtures):
- `--print-json` with the stub reporting BuildKit 0.12.6, 0.13.2, 0.17.3, 0.20.0 and an unreadable version: every case renders `defaultKeepStorage` = 5 GiB and no `maxUsedSpace`. On the current tree, 0.13.2 and later render `maxUsedSpace`, and the unreadable case renders `maxUsedSpace`.
- An existing daemon.json carrying `maxUsedSpace`, `defaultReservedSpace`, `defaultMaxUsedSpace` and `defaultMinFreeSpace` under `builder.gc`: the render drops all four and keeps sibling keys.
- `--print-json` never calls `docker buildx inspect` (no version probe).
- `--buildkit-version` is rejected as an unknown argument (non-zero exit).
- `--check-gc-enforced` 1/0/unreadable cases keep passing unchanged.
- Production shape: Engine 25.0.16 / BuildKit 0.12.6 stub renders byte-identical output to the pre-change script.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `bash infra/scripts/docker-storage-cap.sh --print-json` renders `builder.gc.defaultKeepStorage` = `"5368709120"` and no `maxUsedSpace`, `defaultReservedSpace`, `defaultMaxUsedSpace` or `defaultMinFreeSpace`, whatever BuildKit version the stub reports. Verified by the parametrized tests in `tests/scripts/test_docker_storage_cap.py`.
- [x] For the production shape (Engine 25.0.16, BuildKit 0.12.6, empty daemon.json), `--print-json` output is byte-identical before and after the change. Verified by running the old and new script against the same stub and comparing with `diff`.
- [x] `grep -n 'buildkit-version\|DOCKER_MODERN_GC\|gc_schema_for\|probe_buildkit_version' infra/scripts/docker-storage-cap.sh` prints nothing.
- [x] `.venv/bin/pytest tests/scripts/test_docker_storage_cap.py` passes. `make lint` and `make typecheck` exit 0, with the worktree `.venv/bin` first on PATH. `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` exits 0.
- [x] [non-codebase] The change lands on `main` through Gerrit with `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`.
      provenance: environment=rebar.solutions.navateam.com (Gerrit, project rebar); principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — Gerrit change 3285 read via REST /a/changes/3285 with DETAILED_LABELS: LLM-Review +1 (2026-11-04 04:30:54 UTC), Verified +1 (04:58:11 UTC, GitHub Actions run 41773240328), 0 unresolved comments; submitted at revision 35bd1cfd2bd and merged as 7f43744b13b, now on origin/main.
